title: 形而上学
lead: 在可感现象之下，追问「存在本身」是什么——实体、属性、因果、可能与现实，形而上学试图画出实在的最一般骨架。
leadEn: Beneath the sensible world it asks what being itself is—substance, property, cause, possibility and act—drawing the most general frame of reality.

points.v: 什么真正存在？共相是否实在？变化如何可能？
points.vEn: What truly exists? Are universals real? How is change possible?

points.v: 亚里士多德的实体论与柏拉图的理念论构成持久的张力。
points.vEn: Aristotle's substance and Plato's Forms form a lasting tension.

points.v: 康德指出理性一旦越出经验便陷入二律背反。
points.vEn: Kant showed that reason, past experience, falls into antinomy.

points.v: 分析形而上学重探可能性、必然性与同一性的逻辑。
points.vEn: Analytic metaphysics revisits the logic of possibility, necessity and identity.

title: 认识论
lead: 我们凭什么说「知道」？认识论考察知识的来源、证成与限度，在理性与经验、确定与怀疑之间划界。
leadEn: On what grounds do we say we 'know'? Epistemology examines the source, justification and limits of knowledge, dividing reason from experience, certainty from doubt.

points.v: 理性主义者诉诸天赋观念，经验主义者一切归于感官。
points.vEn: Rationalists appeal to innate ideas; empiricists trace all to the senses.

points.v: 传统将知识解为「被证成的真信念」，盖梯尔反例使其复杂化。
points.vEn: Knowledge as 'justified true belief'—complicated by Gettier's counterexamples.

points.v: 恶魔、梦境与缸中之脑逼迫我们回答认识的确定性。
points.vEn: Demons, dreams and brains-in-vats force us to answer how certain we can be.

points.v: 从过去的规律推出未来，其正当性休谟至今悬而未决。
points.vEn: Inferring the future from the past—its warrant left unresolved since Hume.

sources.label: 笛卡尔《第一哲学沉思集》；休谟《人类理解研究》
sources.labelEn: Descartes, Meditations; Hume, Enquiry Concerning Human Understanding

title: 伦理学
lead: 人应当如何生活、如何行动？伦理学在德性、义务与后果三条路径之间，追问善的理由与正当的标准。
leadEn: How should one live and act? Ethics probes the grounds of the good and the standard of the right along three roads: virtue, duty and consequence.

points.v: 德性论看重品格，义务论看重准则，后果论看重结果。
points.vEn: Virtue ethics prizes character, deontology principle, consequentialism outcomes.

points.v: 道德是客观实在还是主观投射，元伦理学各执一端。
points.vEn: Whether morality is objective fact or projection—metaethics splits.

points.v: 生命、环境、技术与数据伦理把原则带入具体抉择。
points.vEn: Bioethics, environmental, tech and data ethics carry principles into concrete choices.

points.v: 何为良善生活？快乐、德性还是自我实现，答案各异。
points.vEn: What is the good life—pleasure, virtue or flourishing? Answers diverge.

sources.label: 亚里士多德《尼各马可伦理学》；康德《道德形而上学奠基》

title: 逻辑学
lead: 从前提能否必然得出结论？逻辑研究有效推理的形式结构，为数学、计算机与一切论证提供底层规则。
leadEn: Do conclusions follow of necessity from premises? Logic studies the form of valid inference, the base rules for mathematics, computing and every argument.

points.v: 演绎保真、结论已含于前提；归纳扩知、却只给或然。
points.vEn: Deduction preserves truth already in the premises; induction extends yet yields only probability.

points.v: 命题与谓词逻辑以符号刻画联结词与量词的有效性。
points.vEn: Propositional and predicate logic use symbols to fix validity of connectives and quantifiers.

points.v: 说谎者悖论暴露了语言与自我指涉的深层困难。
points.vEn: The liar paradox exposes the deep trouble of language and self-reference.

points.v: 图灵与哥德尔的工作让逻辑走向可计算性与不完备。
points.vEn: Turing and Gödel carried logic toward computability and incompleteness.

sources.label: 亚里士多德《工具论》；弗雷格概念文字

title: 美学
lead: 何为美？审美判断既有主观感受又要求他人认同，美学追问美、崇高与艺术的根据与意义。
leadEn: What is beauty? The aesthetic judgment feels subjective yet demands assent—Aesthetics asks the ground and meaning of beauty, the sublime and art.

points.v: 「趣味无争辩」与人们对美的普遍期许彼此拉扯。
points.vEn: 'No dispute about taste' pulls against our hope for universal agreement on beauty.

points.v: 康德认为审美不涉利害，却仍具普遍可传达性。
points.vEn: Kant held the aesthetic free of interest yet universally communicable.

points.v: 模仿、表现、形式到体制论，艺术的边界不断被重写。
points.vEn: From imitation, expression and form to institutional theory, art's boundary keeps being rewritten.

points.v: 面对浩瀚与威力，痛感转化为一种超越的愉悦。
points.vEn: Before vastness and might, pain turns into a transcendent pleasure.

sources.label: 康德《判断力批判》；鲍姆加登创立美学
sources.labelEn: Kant, Critique of Judgment; Baumgarten founds aesthetics

title: 政治哲学
lead: 权力何时正当、分配怎样公平？政治哲学在正义、自由与秩序之间，为共同生活的制度寻找理由。
leadEn: When is power legitimate, distribution fair? Political Philosophy, between justice, liberty and order, seeks reasons for the institutions of shared life.

points.v: 统治凭神意、契约还是同意？合法性根基历经转移。
points.vEn: Rule by divine will, contract or consent—the ground of legitimacy has shifted.

points.v: 功利、平等与自由至上给出不同的分配原则。
points.vEn: Utility, equality and libertarianism propose rival principles of distribution.

points.v: 从柏拉图哲人王到儒家仁政，构想善治的传统各异。
points.vEn: From Plato's philosopher-kings to Confucian benevolent rule, visions of good governance differ.

points.v: 消极自由、积极自由与差异原则构成当代主线张力。
points.vEn: Negative and positive liberty plus the difference principle form today's chief tension.

sources.label: 柏拉图《理想国》；罗尔斯《正义论》
sources.labelEn: Plato, Republic; Rawls, A Theory of Justice

title: 心灵哲学
lead: 意识如何从物质中涌现？心灵哲学追问心与身的关系、感受质的秘密，以及他心与自我何以可知。
leadEn: How does mind arise from matter? Philosophy of Mind probes the mind–body relation, the riddle of qualia, and how other minds and the self can be known.

points.v: 二元、同一、功能与泛心诸论各试图弥合心与物的裂缝。
points.vEn: Dualism, identity, functionalism and panpsychism each try to bridge mind and matter.

points.v: 「看到红的样子」这类主观体验似乎无法被客观描述穷尽。
points.vEn: 'What red looks like' seems resistant to exhaustive objective description.

points.v: 我只能直接确知自己的心灵，如何推知他人也有意识？
points.vEn: I know my own mind directly—how do I infer others are conscious too?

points.v: 强人工智能与中文房间之争，把问题推向计算的边界。
points.vEn: Strong AI versus the Chinese Room push the question to computation's edge.

sources.label: 笛卡尔《第一哲学沉思集》；当代心灵哲学综述
sources.labelEn: Descartes, Meditations; contemporary surveys of philosophy of mind

title: 科学哲学
lead: 科学凭什么可靠？它考察解释与证成、理论与观察、划界与范式，追问知识增长的真实机制。
leadEn: Why is science trustworthy? It examines explanation and warrant, theory and observation, demarcation and paradigm—the real mechanics of growing knowledge.

points.v: 可证伪性被用来区分科学与非科学，却并非无懈可击。
points.vEn: Falsifiability divides science from non-science, though not without difficulty.

points.v: 有限观察如何支持全称定律，是悬置多年的难题。
points.vEn: How finite observations back universal laws has long remained vexed.

points.v: 库恩指科学并非线性累积，而是经危机换轨。
points.vEn: Kuhn held science advances not by accumulation but through crisis and revolution.

points.v: 电子是否真实存在，还是只是管用的理论虚构？
points.vEn: Are electrons real, or convenient fictions of a working theory?

sources.label: 波普尔《科学发现的逻辑》；库恩《科学革命的结构》
sources.labelEn: Popper, Logic of Scientific Discovery; Kuhn, Structure of Scientific Revolutions

title: 语言哲学
lead: 词如何指物、句如何表意？语言哲学研究意义、指称与使用，二十世纪许多哲学问题都被重述为语言问题。
leadEn: How do words refer, sentences mean? Philosophy of Language studies sense, reference and use—much of twentieth-century philosophy was restated as questions about language.

points.v: 弗雷格区分「晨星」与「暮星」的同指异义。
points.vEn: Frege split the shared reference and differing sense of 'morning star' and 'evening star'.

points.v: 后期维特根斯坦主张意义在于其在生活形式中的使用。
points.vEn: The later Wittgenstein held that meaning lies in use within a form of life.

points.v: 说话即做事——承诺、命令以言行事改变世界。
points.vEn: To speak is to act—promising and ordering do things with words.

points.v: 只关一己、无从公共检验的语言被认为不可能。
points.vEn: A language referencing only one's own, untestable in public, is held impossible.

sources.label: 弗雷格《论意义与指称》；维特根斯坦《哲学研究》
sources.labelEn: Frege, On Sense and Reference; Wittgenstein, Philosophical Investigations

title: 历史哲学
lead: 历史有方向与规律吗？它追问进程是否合乎理性、个体与结构孰轻，以及我们能否理解一个时代。
leadEn: Does history have direction and law? It asks whether the course follows reason, whether agents or structures weigh more, and whether an age can be understood.

points.v: 历史是朝着自由或终点行进，还是只是偶然堆积？
points.vEn: Does history march toward freedom or an end, or is it mere contingent accumulation?

points.v: 马克思以生产方式与阶级斗争解释社会形态的更替。
points.vEn: Marx read the succession of social forms through modes of production and class struggle.

points.v: 史家是客观重演还是被自身视域所限，诠释学各有回答。
points.vEn: Whether historians re-enact objectively or are bound by their own horizon—hermeneutics answers differ.

points.v: 理性、自由与福祉不断增进的信念，两次世界大战后饱受质疑。
points.vEn: The faith in ever-growing reason, liberty and welfare was deeply shaken by the world wars.

sources.label: 黑格尔《历史哲学讲录》；马克思唯物史观
sources.labelEn: Hegel, Lectures on the Philosophy of History; Marx's materialist conception

title: 现象学与诠释学
lead: 回到事情本身——悬置预设、描述意识如何显现世界，再由诠释学追问理解如何在历史与语言中发生。
leadEn: To the things themselves—bracketing presets to describe how consciousness reveals the world, then asking how understanding happens in history and language.

points.v: 意识总是关于某物的意识，主客二分在体验中被消融。
points.vEn: Consciousness is always of something; the subject–object split dissolves in lived experience.

points.v: 一切科学都植根于我们前理论的、直接经验的世界。
points.vEn: All science is rooted in our pre-theoretical, directly lived world.

points.v: 理解部分须借助整体、整体又来自部分，循环而非谬误。
points.vEn: Parts are read through the whole and the whole from parts—a circle, not a fallacy.

points.v: 海德格尔以「在世界中存在」重新追问存在的意义。
points.vEn: Heidegger re-asks the meaning of being through 'being-in-the-world'.

sources.label: 胡塞尔《逻辑研究》；海德格尔《存在与时间》
sources.labelEn: Husserl, Logical Investigations; Heidegger, Being and Time
